Text:
# TRAVELER'S DIARRHEA

## Primary treatment

Hydration and electrolyte replacement

---

References:

- Mandell chapter: Nausea, Vomiting, and Noninflammatory Diarrhea
- Sanford Guide article: Travelers Diarrhea
- DOI: 10.1093/cid/cix669-Shane et al, Clinical Infectious Diseases 2017,
- 65(12):45-80
- Up-to-Date article: Travelers' diarrhea: Epidemiology, microbiology, clinical manifestations, and diagnosis
Therapy:
## Empiric antimicrobial treatment for non-bloody, severe acute diarrhea:

Preferred:
Azithromycin 1000 mg PO one time dose [M]
< OR >
Azithromycin 500 mg PO q24h for 3 days [M]
Alternative:
Ciprofloxacin 500 mg PO q12h for 3 days [R,DI]
< OR >
Rifaximin 200 mg q8h for 3 days [M]
